point: CapacityEvaluationExecutor never renews its lease. Register it as it is, or require the heartbeat first?
what_the_records_say: The executor decision requires a separate 10 s heartbeat that extends a Running lease (DECISION.md:21). The pack repeats "10s scan/renewal" (MOD-0192 :255) and lists the executor as part of the approved composition (:437-438). The code has no caller of RenewAsync (F-Q213-7). With the literal fixture oracle the claim and the terminal write happen in one pass, inside the 30 s lease.
why_no_record_decides_it: No record says whether the missing heartbeat blocks start-up registration or is accepted for the fixture slice.
needed_to_close: A CT ruling: (a) accept the deviation for the fixture slice and register (this proposal's recommendation), or (b) make DECISION.md:21 a precondition: a DEV change in the 43 owned Capacity paths, then registration.
owner: CT + MOD-0192 pack owner; code change, if any, by the Capacity DEV lane, not Q209

point: Value of Returns:ReferenceBaseUrl and Claims:ReferenceBaseUrl, and the file or environment that carries it.
what_the_records_say: Both readers need an absolute http/https base and append the Shipment path; both forward the caller's Authorization and scope headers. Neither key is set anywhere. Q210 says "absolute http/https URL of the Shipment API".
why_no_record_decides_it: No record names the value. Two candidates exist: the Gateway (port 5000, AGENTS.md:79) or the service's own address (port 5061, AGENTS.md:86). AGENTS.md:92 forbids the frontend from calling service ports; it says nothing about service-to-service calls.
needed_to_close: An owner decision on the target (Gateway or direct) and on where the key lives (appsettings.json, environment, secrets). If the Gateway: route 1 of the gateway proposal must exist first.

point: The Kestrel strict UTF-8 selector for the Idempotency-Key header applies to every path, including S&OP.
what_the_records_say: BASE lines 39-45 add it for the whole service. The S&OP pack requires a "nonempty exact parsed" key with no trim, case folding or normalization (:129, :155). A key with invalid UTF-8 would be rejected by the server before the S&OP gate runs, with no S&OP error body.
why_no_record_decides_it: No record read says whether a server-level 400 for an undecodable key is inside or outside the S&OP contract.
needed_to_close: A ruling by the MOD-0190 pack owner (or the SANDOP-CAPACITY contract owner): accepted as "parsed" behaviour, or the selector must be limited by path (Kestrel selects by header name only, so that would need a different mechanism).
